name: julia-dev
description: A versatile software development team that routes greenfield builds, enhancements, debugging, refactoring, review, migration, integration and AI/data work through adaptive workflows.

displayDescription.zh: 茱莉亞統籌的全能開發團，覆蓋新建、除錯、重構、審查、遷移與 AI 應用，按任務類型切換流程交付成果。
